name: TrueFoam
shortInfo: EPS insulation for foundations, under-slab, floors, walls and roofs, made in Atlantic Canada since 1968.
innovation: Foundation Plus insulates and sheathes in one CCMC-evaluated board, and InsulWorks panels hold hydronic tubing for in-floor heating without wire mesh, under slabs designed for heavy loads.
